description_en: Updates the log-related properties of a listener, such as access logs
description_zh: 更新监听日志相关属性，如访问日志等
name: UpdateListenerLogConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance listener
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The log configuration of the listener is not updated. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP_2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会更新监听的日志配置。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP_2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include custom header fields in access logs. Valid values:

true: includes custom header fields.
false (default): does not include custom header fields.

You can set this parameter to true only when the access logging switch AccessLogEnabled is turned on for the instance
parameters.help_zh:
访问日志是否开启携带自定义头字段。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

只有实例访问日志开关AccessLogEnabled打开时，才能设置此参数为true
parameters.name: access_log_record_customized_headers_enabled

fields.help_en:
The status of the Xtrace feature. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false (default): disabled.

You can set this parameter to true only when the access logging switch AccessLogEnabled is turned on for the instance
fields.help_zh:
Xtrace功能状态。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

只有实例访问日志开关AccessLogEnabled打开时，才能设置此参数为true
fields.name: tracing_enabled

fields.help_en:
The Xtrace sampling rate.

Valid values: 1 to 10000.

This parameter takes effect only when TracingEnabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
Xtrace采样率。

取值范围：1~10000。

TracingEnabled为true时有效
fields.name: tracing_sample

fields.help_en:
The type of Xtrace. Valid values: Zipkin and OpenTelemetry.

This parameter takes effect only when TracingEnabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
Xtrace类型，取值为Zipkin、OpenTelemetry。

TracingEnabled为true时有效
fields.name: tracing_type

schema.description_en: The log configuration of the listener
